DB.note: DB odds are the weakest: among waiver DBs the projections barely separate players (see the DB tab).

Among the DBs usually on waivers, the projections barely separate players: on 2025, the 15th to 60th best-projected DBs scored almost without regard to their projections (within-week r 0.08, against 0.18 for LB and 0.13 for DL). What helped, a little, was a full snap share last game and a run of results above projection, which each number here already carries. Treat these tiers as one rough group and prefer the DB who plays every snap.
